title: Build a useful source detail and preview page
objective: A source page answers what it contains, how to use it and what has actually been tested.
outcome: The HCRIS page does not claim source-asserted inferred units or hide its supported API example below boilerplate. Unknown cost/limits remain visible, and a reachable documentation page cannot be presented as proven payload or browser access. Fields and preview match the selected release/distribution; changing context cannot retain an incompatible cached dictionary. A correction contains record/generation/field information without automatically including the user's private research question. An unresolved join is not a confirmed merge. plan_research remains disabled. worker/index.mjs does not import enrichment. HTTP 200 is not a completed research task. Last-good generation live-2026-09-03-85b50522b420 is unchanged.

commits.subject: Put the source decision first
commits.instructions: Lead with purpose, exact product/release, observed coverage/grain, access requirements, last test and a clear source action. Consolidate repetitive unresolved sections. Make credential requirements, access costs, usage limits and the latest successful check easy to scan, distinguishing documented requirements from observed behavior and metadata checks from payload checks. Keep endpoint-specific browser/CORS detail alongside developer recipes.
commits.verification: The HCRIS page does not claim source-asserted inferred units or hide its supported API example below boilerplate. Unknown cost/limits remain visible, and a reachable documentation page cannot be presented as proven payload or browser access.

commits.subject: Add contextual variable and sample inspection
commits.instructions: Provide searchable fields, exact wire names, definitions, unit states, code values and a bounded actual/synthetic example label. Keep pending proposals in a distinct review region.
commits.verification: Fields and preview match the selected release/distribution; changing context cannot retain an incompatible cached dictionary.

commits.subject: Make evidence and correction actions specific
commits.instructions: Attach citations, test receipts and field-level corrections to the visible values; expose important caveats before export or source navigation.
commits.verification: A correction contains record/generation/field information without automatically including the user's private research question.
